description: Priority is ONE decision, and the pair travels together (D2): the state `known` carries the label that makes it mean something to the team. The refusal of the contradiction — `unknown` WITH a label — is named, never precedence-resolved into 'clear the label', and a move back to unknown clears the label as part of the same one decision (the database CHECK agrees: unknown-and-labelled is unwritable). D4's shadow falls here too: this is the write that makes `planned → ready` possible — readiness is re-checked at the attempt, never cached.
